content:
I've been thinking about this lately.

A company has one LinkedIn page.
But it has dozens, sometimes hundreds, of employees.

Each employee has their own network.
Their own experience.
Their own expertise.

So instead of only posting from the company page,
companies can also help employees share:
→ What they're working on
→ What they're learning
→ Industry insights
→ Company initiatives
→ Experiences from their work

Not scripted posts.
Not forced promotions.
📌 Just genuine professional content.

PS: One company page can create visibility.
 But a team of credible employees can create conversations.
comment: The missing piece is often enablement: employees need context, guardrails, and confidence to share authentically. Otherwise advocacy turns into another content task instead of a natural extension of expertise.
